name: Unidentified Mid Rim planet
description: A planet in the Mid Rim was neutral for most of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, but eventually began to welcome ambassadors from both the Empire and the Republic.
lead_paragraphs: A planet in the Mid Rim was neutral for most of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, but eventually began to welcome ambassadors from both the Empire and the Republic.
